question: There is a mention of the term ‘Ayas’ in Rigveda referring to _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __Metal__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Ayas** described in the Rigveda is** Metal**.
 
• The Rigveda or Rig Veda is an archaic Indian collection of Vedic Sanskrit hymns.
 
• It is one of the four holy canonical texts (śruti) of Hinduism known as the Vedas.
 
• The Rigveda is the oldest known Vedic Sanskrit text present till now.
 
• Its early layers are one of the matured extant texts in any Indo-European language.
 
• The sounds and texts of Rigveda have been orally communicated since the 2nd millennium BCE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The philological and linguistic evidence signals that the bulk of the Rigveda Samhita was composed in the northwestern region of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It is most likely between 1500 and 1000 BC although a wider approximation of 1700–1000 BCE has also been given.
 
• The text is layered comprises of the Samhita, Brahmanas, Aranyakas, and Upanishads.
 
• The Rigveda Samhita is the oldest core text and is a collection of 10 books (maṇḍalas) with 1,028 hymns (sūktas) in about 10,600 verses.
